text:
```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Runs at 1 AM UTC every day

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run benchmarks
      run: npm run benchmark:private:e2e

    - name: Create benchmark artifacts directory
      run: mkdir -p benchmarks/private-proof-e2e

    - name: Copy latest benchmark results
      run: cp benchmarks/latest.json benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/latest.json
      run: cp benchmarks/latest.md benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/latest.md

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./benchmarks/private-proof-e2e
```
